svg.aria-label: The sort key, cutout?, doubleSided?, mirrored?, material, mesh, submesh: cutout picks the pipeline, doubleSided the cull mode, mirrored the front face, material set 1, and mesh with submesh the command. The first four are the same for a whole run of commands, which is bound once.
